I now put off seeking medical help, because it's hit and miss if I can get an appointment in person, which can take several weeks of to and fro messages online, despite my need for only in person appointments being the same each time.

I am made to feel like a burden, a waste of space and time, and that I am not deserving of medical care, or that I have to surrender to the will of a power mad bureaucrat.

If these 'double jabs' work, then why are they so adamant about keeping patients away? They either don't believe they provide immunity, or that they are just too lazy to have to deal with patients in person.
